
### how many DHCP servers?  {.smaller}


* DHCP assumption: broadcast to local network and there's the server 
<hr class="vspace" />
* conflicting goals: 

   * want broadcasts not to go too many machines
   * want to have few DHCP servers

* solution: DHCP <i>relays</i>
